statusDetail: Diagnostics can now save the selected handoff into Garage Notes and show a copy/share receipt.
actionRequired: No action needed. Try Diagnostics > Share Summary on iPhone and use Save Note to keep the symptom handoff in Garage Notes.
summary: Added a Diagnostics saved-note receipt so selected no-start, warning-light, 12V power, audio, or trailer handoffs can be saved into existing Garage Notes, copied, shared, or opened in Garage without changing storage schema or vehicle facts.
impactReason: iPhone users can save a symptom handoff directly into Garage Notes before warning-light, no-start, power, audio, or trailer clues fade.
